props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: collapsible
props.description:
When type is "single", allows closing content when clicking trigger for an open item.
When type is "multiple", this prop has no effect.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The default active value of the item(s).

Use when you do not need to control the state of the item(s).

props.name: dir
props.description: The reading direction of the accordion when applicable. If omitted, assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the accordion and all its items

props.name: modelValue
props.description:
The controlled value of the active item(s).

Use this when you need to control the state of the items. Can be bound with `v-model`

props.name: type
props.description:
Determines whether a "single" or "multiple" items can be selected at a time.

This prop will overwrite the inferred type from `modelValue` and `defaultValue`.

props.name: unmountOnHide
props.description: When `true`, the element will be unmounted on closed state.
